finding_detail.evidence: R23StageDirectHold queues D3D11 CopyResource into host-owned textures and marks them valid. The selected direct path does not execute the existing host D3D11 EVENT completion wait/PublishCompletedFrame sequence. R32 producer EVENT is issued in the game D3D9 context after StretchRect and cannot prove completion of later host D3D11 reads. The legacy d3d9ex_direct_passthrough path explicitly CopyResource -> D3D11 EVENT End/Flush/GetData -> PublishCompletedFrame, demonstrating the required ownership transfer ordering.
finding_detail.risk: producer may recycle/overwrite a shared ring slot while host D3D11 CopyResource is still reading it, causing torn/reused eye content under GPU queue latency
finding_detail.recommended_direction: before integrating VR-HOST-002, restore a bounded host-side D3D11 completion fence for selected DirectGPU private copies, or delay per-slot ACK until equivalent D3D11 completion proof. Keep skipped-unsampled immediate ACK behavior.
finding_detail.test_level: LEVEL0 deterministic ownership/ACK verifier + build; HMD only after static verifier passes
